items.exampleEn: The long winter deprived the animals of food.
items.exampleZh: 漫長的冬天讓動物們沒有食物可吃。
下雨破壞了我們的野餐。

items.exampleEn: My fingers were so cold that I couldn't undo the buttons on my coat.
items.exampleZh: 我的手指冷到解不開外套的扣子。

items.exampleEn: Who busted the lock on the gate?
items.exampleZh: 是誰把大門的鎖弄壞的？

items.exampleEn: Long ago, a powerful king conquered this land.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，一位強大的國王征服了這片土地。

items.exampleEn: The dog fetched the ball and brought it back.
Farmers enrich their land with old leaves.
items.exampleZh: 農夫用落葉讓土地更肥沃。

items.exampleEn: The dancer's smooth glide across the floor was perfect.
items.exampleZh: 舞者在地板上平順地滑行，非常完美。

items.sentenceEn: Go and fetch your coat; it's cold outside.
items.sentenceZh: 去拿你的外套，外面很冷。

items.audioEn: Please don't tell me the ending. I don't want you to spoil the story.
items.audioZh: 請不要告訴我結局，我不想讓你破壞這個故事。
items.questionZh: 說話者不希望對方做什麼？
options: Tell the start of the story

items.sentenceEn: The climbers finally conquered the mountain.
items.sentenceZh: 登山者終於征服了那座山。

items.sentenceEn: My old headphones are busted, so I need new ones.
items.sentenceZh: 我的舊耳機壞了，所以我需要買新的。

items.stemEn: Can you ____ the newspaper from the front door for me?
items.stemZh: 你可以幫我去前門把報紙拿過來嗎？

items.stemEn: I made a mistake, so I pressed the button to ____ it.
items.stemZh: 我弄錯了，所以按下按鈕取消。

items.passageEn: Last week, our school held a paper airplane contest. My little brother wanted to help, but he busted my first plane by stepping on it! I didn't want this to spoil my day, so I made a new one. My dad told me not to deprive myself of sleep the night before. On the day of the contest, I asked a friend to fetch some extra paper. On my first try, my plane made a long, beautiful glide across the hall. But a boy's plane hit mine, and one wing broke. I had to undo some folds and fix it quickly. In the end, I won second prize. The contest enriched my school life, and I conquered my fear of competing in front of people. It was a remarkable day.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們學校舉辦了一場紙飛機比賽。我弟弟想幫忙，結果卻一腳踩壞了我的第一架飛機！我不想讓這件事破壞我的一天，所以又做了一架新的。爸爸叫我比賽前一晚不要睡太少。比賽當天，我請一位朋友去多拿一些紙來。第一次試飛時，我的飛機在大廳裡漂亮地滑翔了很長一段。但一個男生的飛機撞上了我的，一邊機翼斷了。我得拆開一些摺痕，趕快把它修好。最後，我得了第二名。這場比賽豐富了我的學校生活，我也戰勝了在眾人面前比賽的恐懼。那真是非凡的一天。

options: 幫作者做了一架又大又漂亮的新飛機
踩壞了作者的第一架飛機

questions.questionZh: 機翼斷了之後，作者怎麼做？
options: 請老師再給一次機會，重新做一架
拆開一些摺痕，趕快修好

I need to fetch my sister from school before five o'clock.
